Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: original supporting artwork for one Indonesian small-business Instagram carousel, portrait 4:5. Brand context: Loka Kasir. Create a striking art-directed visual which tells this specific business situation through actual objects and setting. No text, letters, numerals, signs, logos, UI screenshots, charts, A/B/C cards, watermark, or infographic boxes. Keep the top 30 percent relatively quiet for a separately typeset headline; put the main scene in the bottom 70 percent, large enough to read on a phone. Clean deliberate composition, craft and material detail, restrained cobalt-blue accents with the scene's own colors. Fictional illustrative scene, never imply a real customer testimonial.
Specific story: buying three wholesale cartons looks cheap but two stay unsold and tie up the shop's money. Style: sophisticated tactile 3D diorama, slightly surreal but physically believable. A small Indonesian grocery shelf and counter, viewed from a low three-quarter angle. One opened kraft carton contains just a few glass drink bottles that sold; two much larger unopened cartons crowd the counter, with a coiled long blank paper receipt trapped underneath and a small coin jar nearly empty beside them. A tiny female shopkeeper in a cobalt apron looks at the crowded storage space. Peach-orange background, warm kraft textures, blue shelf, amber glass. Make the boxes and bottle stock the dominant objects, not a generic cashier portrait. No writing on cartons.

Specific story: the owner's favorite menu item is not necessarily what customers order. Style: premium editorial photographic paper collage with crisp torn-paper edges and realistic food cutouts, not an infographic. An Indonesian cafe tabletop seen from overhead: a meticulously decorated slice of pistachio cake stands untouched on a little pedestal at lower left, while a real barista's hand fills a takeaway tray with several iced coffees and simple sandwiches at lower right. One handwritten-looking but entirely blank order slip curls through the middle. Deliberate asymmetrical composition with tactile cream paper, cobalt-blue tabletop fragments, pistachio green, warm coffee browns, and soft flash shadows. Food and actual outgoing orders tell the contrast. No numbers, no labels, no letters, no comparison cards.
